verdict: No additional source blocker found in the bounded Write/WriteBuffer successor. Accept for Root source intake and later independent native qualification.
scope: Independent source and exact-byte review only. No compiler, parser, metadata query, runtime or Node capture.
source_findings: Write accounts all attempted bytes before DoTryWrite; partial vectors leave that original total unchanged. Both skip_try_write and non-null send handle bypass the original try-write path.

Native result owns the retained BaseObjectPtr separately from its exposed WriteWrap pointer. Synchronous Dispose clears the request slot but the returned result retains the native state until release.

The error-property IsNothing path retires the local pointer before restoring the default trigger and returns EBUSY with zero result bytes. Accepted asynchronous requests are not spuriously disposed by a later setter exception.

The actual WriteWrap template has separate request/native fields, the real AsyncWrap prototype and provider 52, and lacks the three own ShutdownWrap data fields. Existing Shutdown bindings retain their prior fallback timing.
Original ordinary init-hook exceptions preserve the completed native request and continue through MakeWeak and DoWrite; fatal/port failures stay failures.

WriteBuffer uses the real Uint8Array predicate/view pointer/byte length, intrinsic TypeError and original observable code Set. It publishes shared Int32 result fields before retiring the local result pointer.
Default and CustomBuffer listeners use the shared actual completion reporter. Write completion still disposes after a callback throw and does not reread the stream/listener afterward.

Backing-store ownership transfers once and remains alive through logical Dispose. State retirement clears AsyncWrap/BaseObject ownership before the derived destroy releases the WriteWrap backing token, matching reverse base destruction.
The FileHandle adapter is the retained original UV_ENOSYS body; it does not claim an OS write. The first packet receiver/alive/default-trigger guards remain before argument checks.

controls.observed_coverage: Read complete test fixture and all 20 cases, including physical descriptor/ENOSYS, request-slot versus native-pointer lifetime, try-write totals and bypass, real warning/error ordering, ordinary init-hook throw, live completion forwarding, disabled JS, backing token, receiver guards, and accepted async with later setter failure.

integration: Apply after the first JS-dispatch packet. Compose only the 1692-byte additive build hunk with the accepted combined Module/first-StreamBase build; do not overwrite that composed build with this standalone projection.
remaining_scope: Vector/string write callbacks and external_stream are still required for full AddMethods/public FileHandle publication.
The separate IPC branch requires a concrete HandleWrap unwrap/GetHandle owner; FileHandle is non-IPC.
Embedding template/key, trace, allocation and event-loop owners remain required.
Native compilation, actual metadata/runtime evidence and application bridge removal are not claimed.
